panels.title: 지난밤 수면
panels.description: 가장 최근 밤의 총 수면 시간 (깨어있던 시간 제외). 권장 7–9시간

targets.rawSql:
WITH seg AS (
    SELECT toDate(end_time + INTERVAL 6 HOUR, '${tz}') AS night, source_name, category,
           dateDiff('second', start_time, end_time) AS secs, start_time, end_time
    FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
    WHERE type = 'sleep_analysis' AND category != 'in_bed' AND end_time > now() - INTERVAL 3 DAY
),
best AS (
    SELECT night, argMax(source_name, asleep) AS src
    FROM (SELECT night, source_name, sumIf(secs, category LIKE 'asleep%') AS asleep
          FROM seg GROUP BY night, source_name)
    GROUP BY night
),
nights AS (
    SELECT seg.night AS night, seg.source_name AS source_name, seg.category AS category,
           seg.secs AS secs, seg.start_time AS start_time, seg.end_time AS end_time
    FROM seg INNER JOIN best ON seg.night = best.night AND seg.source_name = best.src
)
SELECT sumIf(secs, category LIKE 'asleep%') / 3600 AS v FROM nights WHERE night = (SELECT max(night) FROM nights)
SELECT argMax(value, start_time) AS v FROM ${db}.samples FINAL WHERE type = 'resting_heart_rate' AND start_time > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY

panels.title: 마지막 수신
panels.description: iPhone 앱에서 마지막으로 데이터를 받은 시각

targets.rawSql: SELECT toUnixTimestamp64Milli(max(received_at)) AS v FROM ${db}.sync_log

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT toDate(end_time + INTERVAL 6 HOUR, '${tz}') AS night, source_name, category,
           dateDiff('second', start_time, end_time) AS secs, start_time, end_time
    FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
    WHERE type = 'sleep_analysis' AND category != 'in_bed' AND end_time >= toStartOfDay($__fromTime, '${tz}') - INTERVAL 6 HOUR AND end_time < $__toTime
),
best AS (
    SELECT night, argMax(source_name, asleep) AS src
    FROM (SELECT night, source_name, sumIf(secs, category LIKE 'asleep%') AS asleep
          FROM seg GROUP BY night, source_name)
    GROUP BY night
),
nights AS (
    SELECT seg.night AS night, seg.source_name AS source_name, seg.category AS category,
           seg.secs AS secs, seg.start_time AS start_time, seg.end_time AS end_time
    FROM seg INNER JOIN best ON seg.night = best.night AND seg.source_name = best.src
)
SELECT time, asleep AS `수면 시간`,
       avg(asleep) OVER (ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `7일 평균`
FROM (SELECT toDateTime(night, '${tz}') AS time, sumIf(secs, category LIKE 'asleep%') / 3600 AS asleep
      FROM nights GROUP BY time)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: 수면 단계
panels.description: 기상일 기준. 같은 밤을 여러 앱/기기가 기록했다면 수면 시간이 가장 긴 소스 하나만 사용

targets.rawSql:
WITH seg AS (
    SELECT toDate(end_time + INTERVAL 6 HOUR, '${tz}') AS night, source_name, category,
           dateDiff('second', start_time, end_time) AS secs, start_time, end_time
    FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
    WHERE type = 'sleep_analysis' AND category != 'in_bed' AND end_time >= toStartOfDay($__fromTime, '${tz}') - INTERVAL 6 HOUR AND end_time < $__toTime
),
best AS (
    SELECT night, argMax(source_name, asleep) AS src
    FROM (SELECT night, source_name, sumIf(secs, category LIKE 'asleep%') AS asleep
          FROM seg GROUP BY night, source_name)
    GROUP BY night
),
nights AS (
    SELECT seg.night AS night, seg.source_name AS source_name, seg.category AS category,
           seg.secs AS secs, seg.start_time AS start_time, seg.end_time AS end_time
    FROM seg INNER JOIN best ON seg.night = best.night AND seg.source_name = best.src
)
SELECT toDateTime(night, '${tz}') AS time,
  sumIf(secs, category = 'asleep_deep') / 3600 AS `깊은 수면`,
  sumIf(secs, category = 'asleep_core') / 3600 AS `코어 수면`,
  sumIf(secs, category = 'asleep_rem') / 3600 AS `렘 수면`,
  sumIf(secs, category = 'awake') / 3600 AS `깨어남`,
  sumIf(secs, category = 'asleep_unspecified') / 3600 AS `수면(미분류)`
FROM nights GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT toDate(end_time + INTERVAL 6 HOUR, '${tz}') AS night, source_name, category,
           dateDiff('second', start_time, end_time) AS secs, start_time, end_time
    FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
    WHERE type = 'sleep_analysis' AND category != 'in_bed' AND end_time >= toStartOfDay($__fromTime, '${tz}') - INTERVAL 6 HOUR AND end_time < $__toTime
),
best AS (
    SELECT night, argMax(source_name, asleep) AS src
    FROM (SELECT night, source_name, sumIf(secs, category LIKE 'asleep%') AS asleep
          FROM seg GROUP BY night, source_name)
    GROUP BY night
),
nights AS (
    SELECT seg.night AS night, seg.source_name AS source_name, seg.category AS category,
           seg.secs AS secs, seg.start_time AS start_time, seg.end_time AS end_time
    FROM seg INNER JOIN best ON seg.night = best.night AND seg.source_name = best.src
)
SELECT toString(night) AS `날짜`,
  formatDateTime(minIf(start_time, category LIKE 'asleep%'), '%H:%i', '${tz}') AS `잠든 시각`,
  formatDateTime(maxIf(end_time, category LIKE 'asleep%'), '%H:%i', '${tz}') AS `깬 시각`,
  round(sumIf(secs, category LIKE 'asleep%') / 3600, 1) AS `총 수면(시간)`,
  round(sumIf(secs, category = 'asleep_deep') / 60) AS `깊은(분)`,
  round(sumIf(secs, category = 'asleep_core') / 60) AS `코어(분)`,
  round(sumIf(secs, category = 'asleep_rem') / 60) AS `렘(분)`,
  round(sumIf(secs, category = 'awake') / 60) AS `깸(분)`,
  any(source_name) AS `기록 소스`
FROM nights GROUP BY night ORDER BY night DESC

panels.title: 안정시 심박 · 걷기 평균 심박
panels.description: 둘 다 낮아질수록 심폐 체력이 좋아지는 신호

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(start_time, '${tz}') AS time, transform(type, ['resting_heart_rate', 'walking_heart_rate_average'], ['안정시 심박', '걷기 평균 심박'], type) AS series, avg(value) AS value
FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
WHERE type IN ('resting_heart_rate', 'walking_heart_rate_average') AND start_time >= toStartOfDay($__fromTime, '${tz}') AND start_time < $__toTime
GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.title: 심박 변이도 (HRV)
panels.description: SDNN 기준. 높을수록 회복 상태가 좋은 편

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, v AS `일 평균`, avg(v) OVER (ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `7일 평균`
FROM (SELECT toStartOfDay(start_time, '${tz}') AS time, avg(value) AS v FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
      WHERE type = 'heart_rate_variability' AND start_time >= toStartOfDay($__fromTime, '${tz}') AND start_time < $__toTime GROUP BY time)
ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfDay(start_time, '${tz}') AS time, transform(type, ['vo2_max'], ['VO₂ max'], type) AS series, avg(value) AS value
FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
WHERE type IN ('vo2_max') AND start_time >= toStartOfDay($__fromTime, '${tz}') AND start_time < $__toTime
GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfDay(start_time, '${tz}') AS time, transform(type, ['oxygen_saturation'], ['혈중 산소'], type) AS series, avg(value) AS value
FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
WHERE type IN ('oxygen_saturation') AND start_time >= toStartOfDay($__fromTime, '${tz}') AND start_time < $__toTime
GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfDay(start_time, '${tz}') AS time, transform(type, ['respiratory_rate'], ['호흡수'], type) AS series, avg(value) AS value
FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
WHERE type IN ('respiratory_rate') AND start_time >= toStartOfDay($__fromTime, '${tz}') AND start_time < $__toTime
GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time, avg(value) AS `평균`, min(value) AS `최저`, max(value) AS `최고`
FROM ${db}.samples FINAL WHERE type = 'heart_rate' AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: 주별 운동 기록 시간
panels.description: Watch로 기록한 운동(근력 운동 등)의 주간 합계, 월요일 시작

targets.rawSql:

FROM ${db}.workouts FINAL WHERE start_time >= toStartOfDay($__fromTime, '${tz}') AND start_time < $__toTime GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: 걷기 비대칭 (일 평균)
panels.description: 좌우 걸음 시간 차이. iPhone을 바지 주머니에 넣고 걸을 때 측정되며, 휴대 방식에 따라 달라질 수 있음

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(start_time, '${tz}') AS time, transform(type, ['walking_asymmetry'], ['걷기 비대칭'], type) AS series, avg(value) AS value
FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
WHERE type IN ('walking_asymmetry') AND start_time >= toStartOfDay($__fromTime, '${tz}') AND start_time < $__toTime
GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfDay(start_time, '${tz}') AS time, transform(type, ['walking_speed'], ['걷기 속도'], type) AS series, avg(value) * 3.6 AS value
FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
WHERE type IN ('walking_speed') AND start_time >= toStartOfDay($__fromTime, '${tz}') AND start_time < $__toTime
GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfDay(start_time, '${tz}') AS time, transform(type, ['walking_step_length'], ['보폭'], type) AS series, avg(value) * 100 AS value
FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
WHERE type IN ('walking_step_length') AND start_time >= toStartOfDay($__fromTime, '${tz}') AND start_time < $__toTime
GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT start_time AS time, value AS `체중` FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
WHERE type = 'body_mass' AND $__timeFilter(start_time) ORDER BY time

SELECT start_time AS time, value AS `제지방량` FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
WHERE type = 'lean_body_mass' AND $__timeFilter(start_time) ORDER BY time

SELECT start_time AS time, value AS `체지방률` FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
WHERE type = 'body_fat_percentage' AND $__timeFilter(start_time) ORDER BY time

SELECT start_time AS time, value AS `BMI` FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
WHERE type = 'body_mass_index' AND $__timeFilter(start_time) ORDER BY time
SELECT argMax(device_name, received_at) AS v FROM ${db}.sync_log
SELECT count() AS v FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
SELECT count() AS v FROM ${db}.workouts FINAL

SELECT $__timeInterval(received_at) AS time, sum(samples) AS `샘플`, sum(stats) AS `시간별 통계`, sum(workouts) AS `운동`
FROM ${db}.sync_log WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT type AS `타입`, '샘플' AS `구분`, count() AS `건수`, min(start_time) AS `최초`, max(end_time) AS `최신`
FROM ${db}.samples FINAL GROUP BY type
UNION ALL SELECT type, '시간별 통계', count(), min(bucket_start), max(bucket_end) FROM ${db}.quantity_stats FINAL GROUP BY type
UNION ALL SELECT 'workout', '운동', count(), min(start_time), max(end_time) FROM ${db}.workouts FINAL HAVING count() > 0
ORDER BY 1, 2
